models.name: naive_bayes

models.name: logistic_regression

models.name: linear_svm
models.description: Max-margin linear classifier; margins are not probabilities, so they are Platt-calibrated.

models.name: lightgbm
models.description: Gradient-boosted trees on a reduced TF-IDF vocabulary plus raw structured features.
